name: Buddy Punch
description: Buddy Punch is time tracking and employee scheduling software. This connector lets Claude view employees, time cards, and punches; create and edit punches; manage schedules and shifts; and review and act on PTO/time-off requests — all using your existing Buddy Punch account. Every tool carries read-only and destructive-action annotations so Claude asks before making changes. Connect as an Administrator to get started.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Buddy Punch to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Buddy Punch to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api2.buddypunch.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Buddy Punch MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Buddy Punch lists 61 MCP tools, including approve_time_card, assign_department_code_employees, assign_geofence_employees, assign_location_department_codes, assign_location_employees, create_department_code, create_employee, create_geofence, create_group, create_location, create_position, and create_shift.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Buddy Punch?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Buddy Punch in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Buddy Punch MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Buddy Punch requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Buddy Punch is developed by Buddy Punch. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
